messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: High 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in prod us-west-2 (Alert: A-12345). Current 5xx spike: 18% across frontends. Paging @emma (oncall). Please ack and follow standard incident runbook.

emma (oncall): acked. jumping on bridge now — joining in 1m. any customer-facing alerts? cc @cs-josh

cs-josh: Got one DM from customer 'AcmeRetail' reporting timeouts in checkout logging ~50% failures. No public status page update yet.

emma (oncall): starting quick scope: checking console metrics vs API. Console shows cluster healthy but error budget spike in telemetry. odd.

ops-aly: copying logs from edge:```
[2025-06-14T18:02:01Z] router-1 INFO request id=abcd path=/v1/generate status=502 backend=downstream-1
[2025-06-14T18:02:03Z] router-2 INFO request id=abce path=/v1/generate status=503 backend=downstream-2
[2025-06-14T18:02:05Z] router-3 INFO request id=abcf path=/v1/generate status=504 backend=downstream-1
```looks like downstream errors, but control plane (console) still says routing config version 42.

emma (oncall): hypothesis 1: config/state divergence — console control-plane shows current routing flag, but dataplane hasn't picked it up. Hypothesis 2: transient backend overload due to new batcher settings. will run quick checks.

eng-zoe: FYI we rolled an autoscaling tweak to batcher service at 18:00 (about 5m before alert). rollout id: rollout/2025-06-14-batcher-tweak. Could be related.

emma (oncall): timeline so far (building):
- 17:59:45 UTC: rollout/2025-06-14-batcher-tweak started (eng-zoe)
- 18:00:12 UTC: first errors appear in router logs (ops-aly)
- 18:01:05 UTC: incident-bot threshold breached, page sent (this thread root)
- 18:03:00 UTC: on-call bridge formed, initial triage (this thread)

sre-mike: running quick probe to confirm control-plane -> dataplane config version.

sre-mike: result from control plane API: `GET /api/config/state` returns `{"version": 42, "flags": {"enable_new_routing": true}}`

sre-mike: from dataplane node `router-1`: `/run/state` shows `version=41` and `flags.enable_new_routing=false`. so we have a propagation lag / failed rollout to dataplane.

emma (oncall): good catch. that explains console vs API discrepancy: console reads control plane state; routers run old config. potential cause: rollout agent crashed during batcher tweak deploy.

eng-zoe: checking deployment logs. I see that the batcher tweak included an envoy sidecar restart that bumped the rollout controller. controller pod `rollout-controller-9` OOM-killed at 17:59:58 UTC. logs:```
OOMKilled: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError at com.rollout.Controller.apply(Controller.java:213)
```

ops-aly: if rollout controller died, it would leave dataplane at previous version while control plane persisted new desired state. that matches.

emma (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) reapply config to dataplane nodes directly (force push) 2) rollback batcher tweak if we see risk 3) notify customers with impacted requests. I'm taking step 1 now.

emma (oncall): running force push:```bash
# push version 42 to routers (safety: dry-run=false)
for node in $(cat routers.txt); do ssh $node "/usr/local/bin/rollout-agent apply --version 42" & done
```

ops-aly: logs show some nodes accepted v42, others failing with TLS handshake errors to control-plane:```
2025-06-14T18:04:12Z ERROR control-conn tls handshake failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
```

eng-zoe: those TLS errors correlate with a cert rotation that happened 16:50 — maybe some nodes missed the rotation. we have partial cert set on fleet.

emma (oncall): switching mitigation to fallback: enable failover routing to dedicated-prod-2 (no config change required, route policy exists). Doing failover now.

ops-aly: policy toggle: `route-policy set /v1/generate fallback=dedicated-prod-2` -> applied. traffic shifting. seeing p50 latency increase by 20% but 5xx drop to ~1.2% within 90s.

cs-josh: started status update to affected customers: noted traffic shift and mitigation. will post to status page and DM top customers.

emma (oncall): handoff: @raj, I need to hand this off for follow-up and RCA postmortem. Current state — failover applied, partial rollout failure due to rollout-controller OOM + cert rotation mismatch. Customers experiencing transient failures and delayed retries. I will stay on until you confirm handoff.

raj (oncall-next): taking it. joining bridge now. will coordinate cleanup and RCA. thanks @emma.

sre-mike: for RCA notes: we should collect:
- rollout-controller pod logs and OOM traces
- cert rotation job logs and node subset that missed rotation
- rollouts history for batcher tweak (timestamps + manifests)
- router logs for error sampling (include request ids)
- control plane persistence timestamps (when version 42 was written)

eng-zoe: I'll dump rollout-controller logs and the rollout manifest. attaching snippet:```
rollout-controller logs: 17:59:55 INFO apply manifest v42
17:59:58 ERROR OOMKilled
18:02:10 INFO controller restarted, reconciled in 18s
```

ops-aly: node cert rotation job shows 16:50:00 UTC rotation started, job autoscaler limited concurrency and some nodes didn't get their new certs until 18:05:00 due to throttling.

emma (oncall): framing hypothesis chain in-thread:
1) rollout-controller OOM kills at 17:59:58 while reconciler was applying v42 -> control-plane persists v42 but dataplane didn't get reconciled (state divergence).
2) cert rotation concurrency limit caused a subset of nodes to fail TLS with control plane during force push at 18:04 -> prevented some routers from accepting v42.
3) Batch tweak may have increased connection churn, amplifying failures but not root cause.

raj (oncall-next): agree. next actions for post-incident RCA:
- SRE: correlate node list that remained at v41 and find overlap with failed cert rotation list. (sre-mike)
- Eng: add liveness check to rollout-controller to avoid OOM windows and reduce reconcilation pause. (eng-zoe)
- Ops: increase cert-rotation concurrency or use backoff that prioritizes control-plane connectivity. (ops-aly)
- CS: finalize customer comms and credits if necessary. (cs-josh)

sre-mike: collecting logs now. I'll paste a minimal timeline once I correlate node IDs.

sre-mike: preliminary timeline (to be expanded):
- 16:50:00 UTC: cert-rotation job kicked off (partial)
- 17:59:45 UTC: eng rollback-controller started applying v42
- 17:59:58 UTC: rollout-controller OOMKilled -> reconciler paused
- 18:00:12 UTC: first 502/503 observed in routers
- 18:01:05 UTC: alert threshold breached, incident-bot pages oncall
- 18:04:30 UTC: force push attempted, some nodes fail TLS and stay at v41
- 18:05:55 UTC: failover to dedicated-prod-2 applied -> errors drop

emma (oncall): adding to thread: if we need immediate low-effort fix for future, we should make the control-plane persist a "force-rollout-on-restart" marker so that controller restart reconciles quickly. capturing as action item.

eng-zoe: noted. will propose a small PR to add a persisted watermark and a small resource increase to rollout-controller.

raj (oncall-next): I'll own tracking action items and scheduling RCA doc. tagging next steps in the incident board. thanks all — I'll keep this thread as the single source for logs/timeline/hypotheses.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: severity set to Sev2, bridge owner set to raj, RCA board created at https://rboard/internal/INC-2025-06-14-1765500000.

cs-josh: posting customer status update now. will include mitigation details and ETA for full restoration (when rollout completes).

emma (oncall): leaving bridge, handoff complete. good job everyone. :thumbsup:

raj (oncall-next): confirmed handoff — I have the bridge and will run follow-ups. I'll paste final timeline + artifacts in this thread when ready.
